name: usePlayIntegrity
summary: Hardware security feature flags and Android Keystore key attestation. No Play Integrity verdict is produced.
plain: Reports which hardware keystore features the device declares and whether Google Play Services is installed, and can generate an attested key and return its real certificate chain. It does not call the Play Integrity API and does not say whether the device is rooted.
description: Reads the android.hardware.strongbox_keystore, android.hardware.hardware_keystore (FeatureInfo.version), android.hardware.keystore.app_attest_key and android.hardware.security.model.compatible system features and whether com.google.android.gms is installed. requestAttestation generates an EC key with an attestation challenge (StrongBox when the device declares it, with a fallback to the default keystore), reads KeyInfo.getSecurityLevel() (API 31+), and returns the certificate chain (base64, leaf first), its length, the leaf subject and issuer, and the challenge bytes actually used (generated when none is passed). The chain is returned as produced by the Keystore: this hook does not verify it. Verify it on a server against the challenge and Google's attestation roots. No Play Integrity API call is made and no integrity verdict is produced.

returns.name: isSupported
returns.desc: True when the device declares StrongBox or hardware keystore, or Google Play Services is installed.

returns.name: hasStrongBox
returns.desc: Whether the device declares the StrongBox keystore feature.

returns.name: strongBoxVersion
returns.desc: StrongBox keystore feature version (FeatureInfo.version), or null when not declared.

returns.name: hardwareKeystoreVersion
returns.desc: Hardware keystore feature version (FeatureInfo.version), or null when not declared.

returns.name: playServicesAvailable
returns.desc: Whether the Google Play Services package is installed.

returns.name: isAttesting
returns.desc: Whether a cryptographic attestation operation is running.

returns.name: lastAttestation
returns.desc: Result of the last key attestation, including certificateChainBase64 and the challenge used.

returns.name: requestAttestation
returns.desc: Generates an attested EC key in the Android Keystore (StrongBox when available) and returns its certificate chain.

actions.name: requestAttestation(challenge?)
actions.desc: Generates an attested EC key and returns the certificate chain (base64), the key's security level from KeyInfo (null when unreadable) and the challenge used. Resolves null on failure with the reason in error.
